model_annotation: The line plot aims to illustrate the relationship between the number of iterations and the loss across different L-layered neural network models with varying configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and exhibits a linear scale with tick labels ranging from 0 to 14,000 at increments of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss and depicts a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, marked at regular intervals. The plot includes six distinct lines representing different models or settings, each with its own color and line style. The "Vanilla" model (purple line) starts at a loss near 3.4 and decreases sharply to just above 2.6. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue line) also begins near 3.4 and decreases to just under 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64)" (red line) starts slightly above the blue line and converges to a loss value similar to StrmLLM. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" (orange line) shows a starting point close to the red line and follows the same downward trend. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (green line) begins with a loss slightly less than the orange line and subsequently aligns with the previous model's loss. The "SepLLM (n=128)" (light blue line) starts with a loss just above 3.3 and follows the same downward trend as the other models. Throughout all model styles, the loss tends to decrease as the number of iterations increases, with the light blue line (SepLLM (n=128)) generally maintaining the lowest loss at the end of the iterations.
